title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final answer as (c).

title: Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide reasoning for why electron density oscillates with decreasing amplitude.

title: Understanding of Concepts
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of atomic structure and electron behavior.

title: Alternative Answers
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss why options (a) and (b) are incorrect.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid misinterpreting the behavior of electron density as decreasing like a Gaussian or exponentially.
